selection_criterion: First generator seed in 0..199 where the production engine finds the claim (Random Forest beats Logistic Regression by >= 5.0 pp accuracy) met on the default split (seed 42) and on 1-3 of the 5 alternate splits, with no critical diagnostic.
honesty_note: This dataset was selected to illustrate split sensitivity. It is synthetic and does not describe real machines. All numbers shown in LabMirror are recomputed live.
